# `range`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns a table of values within a specified range.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
range(start[, end[, step[, numSlices]]]) / range(end)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `table_funcs` |
| Kind | table function |
| Added in Spark | 2.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | - |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- range, example 1
> SELECT * FROM range(1);
0
```

```sql
-- range, example 2
> SELECT * FROM range(0, 2);
0
1
```

```sql
-- range, example 3
> SELECT * FROM range(0, 4, 2);
0
2
```
